input.change_text: Added support for server-driven extension deny lists

output.subject: Windsurf supports server-driven extension deny lists
output.action_text: Configure `server-driven extension deny lists` in Windsurf (2026-04-27 release) if your org needs central control over which IDE extensions clients can load. Opt-in capability; existing per-client extension policy continues to work unchanged when the server list is absent.
